--- a/minbpe/basic.py
+++ b/minbpe/basic.py
@@ -218,1 +218,20 @@
-def _replace_table(merges):
+def _replace_all(s, table):
+    """
+    s.replace(ps, c) for every (ps, c) in table, in order, skipping the merges
+    whose tokens cannot both occur in s (those replacements are no-ops).
+    present is a superset of the characters of s: a replacement only removes
+    characters, besides adding c.
+    """
+    present = set(s)
+    add = present.add
+    replace = str.replace
+    for ps, c in table:
+        if ps[0] in present and ps[1] in present:
+            n = len(s)
+            s = replace(s, ps, c)
+            if len(s) != n:
+                add(c)
+    return s
+

+def _replace_table(merges):
